steps.prompt_exact: Can you make me a phone-friendly one-file browser tool for improving forum replies? I want to paste the original question and my rough answer, then get helpfulness/evidence/tone scores, risky wording flags, and a short copyable checklist for making the reply more useful.
steps.response_summary: ChatGPT returned a complete single-file HTML forum reply improver with local scoring for helpfulness, evidence, and tone, risk flags, sample input, local storage, copy, download, and reset controls.

Forum Reply Improver

Paste the original question and your rough reply. This local-only checker scores usefulness, evidence, and tone, then gives you flags and a copyable improvement checklist.

Tip: the better the question context, the better the usefulness score.
